# SI053 — dict-ordering-dependence

Do not depend on plain-dict iteration order.

## Why

Python dict order is insertion-based, but different validators can insert keys in different orders. Sort explicitly.

## Bad

```python
for key in evidence_map: ...
```

## Good

```python
for key in sorted(evidence_map): ...
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI053 -- reason
```
